# ClickDetector

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("ClickDetector")`

Lets a player click the part or model it is parented to. Every tick the engine casts a ray from the pointer, a mouse cursor or a tap, into the world. The nearest part that has a detector, on itself or on a model that contains it, is the one pointed at. A part with `CanQuery` off is ignored.

In a multiplayer match, a click is sent to the authority, which checks the distance from the player's character and fires `MouseClick` with the player. The machine that clicked also fires it, so local scripts react at once. Hover events fire only on the local machine.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CursorIcon` | `Content` | `""` | read/write, **stored, not yet acted on** | The image the pointer shows over the detector. The value is saved and replicated but is not used yet: the pointer does not change. |
| `MaxActivationDistance` | `number` | `32` | read/write | The largest distance from the player's character, in meters, at which a click counts. With no character, it is measured from the camera. |

## Events

Signals are deferred: a handler runs at the next resumption point, not
inside the call that fired the signal.

### `MouseClick(player: Player)`

Fires when the primary button is pressed, or a tap lands, on the detector within range.

### `MouseHoverEnter(player: Player)`

Fires when the pointer moves onto the detector within range. It fires only on the local machine.

### `MouseHoverLeave(player: Player)`

Fires when the pointer leaves the detector or the detector goes out of range. It fires only on the local machine.

### `RightMouseClick(player: Player)`

Fires when the secondary button is pressed on the detector within range.
